layouts.name: Walls + loft
layouts.system: Uncut pine wall shelves · no floor rack
layouts.summary: Keep floor-standing racks out. Ready-size recess units handle small items, a long high left run and an added right-front shelf supplement the existing ski shelf. Shallow rear wall shelves leave a tall sled space and the most rear floor clearance. Under the loft, high shelves suit flat items; bulky seasonal gear goes on the loft.
layouts.equipment: One sled, accessible folded ladder, skis, mixed bags and small items. Loft reserved for infrequent bulky storage.
layouts.unpriced: Product subtotal includes VAT. Delivery, labour, finish and substrate-specific screws / backing are extra and unpriced. Wall fixing and door-track clearance require checking on site; nothing is claimed structurally approved.

layouts.name: Balanced daily storage
layouts.system: Two BROR 55 cm racks + recess modules
layouts.summary: Two 55 cm deep BROR units provide mixed-height, reachable storage. Ready-made recess units and shorter high shelves handle small and flat items; the remaining rear bay holds the sled. Keeps more open wall above the passage than A. My starting recommendation if you want mostly ready-size parts.
